text_simplified: The text discusses the role of the masjid in Islamic tarbiyah (upbringing), based on the seerah of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. It clarifies that the masjid was not merely a place of worship but a comprehensive educational and tarbiyah institution. It also shows that the Prophet ﷺ dedicated time to teaching both women and men and addressed incorrect behaviors. The aim is to guide parents on the importance of the masjid in raising children.
